title: Delete a place
goal: The owner can remove an unused place without losing trip stops
acceptance: Delete a place from the saved-place list or edit form only after a keyboard-operable confirmation; announce success and errors, with focus returned to the places page

The existing DELETE /api/places/:id endpoint refuses with HTTP 409 when a trip endpoint or stop references the place; the clear error names every affected trip and leaves the place and trip references unchanged
Deleting a place that is not a trip stop removes it from the service and list; regression tests cover the API and the UI/service join
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no owner places, home address, photos, routes or API keys in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Added 2026-11-27 after the owner walkthrough; implementation, local checks and CI #29 passed 2026-11-27. No actual: job timing is unavailable.
